views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the arch in the yew hedge onto the sunlit strip of long grass and the pressed hollow where the Gryphon lies
low medium shot through the grass heads from beside the gate-pier toward the pressed hollow in the long grass
low-angle close shot from the grass looking up at the small weathered stone griffin on its carved halo cap
eye-level wide shot from the long grass over the ha-ha coping into the bright pale haze and the faint line of sea-light
eye-level wide shot along the top of the ha-ha from its east end to the gate-pier, the grass strip on the right and the haze on the left
eye-level detail from the ha-ha coping on the sun-warmed flattened grass, poppies and cornflowers in the hollow
low medium shot from the lower ground below the ha-ha looking up the dry-stone wall face to the gate-pier
high oblique medium shot from above the long grass toward the arch in the yew hedge, the way back to the croquet-ground
eye-level medium shot from the east end of the ha-ha across the grass to the arch in the yew hedge
